title.narrative: Technical Assistance to Support the Ministry of Health and Regions to manage the Social Determinants of Health (SDH) for Gender Equality Program in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The purpose of this contract is:to support Ethiopia's Developing Regional States (DRS) and the Federal Ministry of Health to develop Regional Grant proposals/project documents to be financed from the Social Determinants of Health (SDH) for Gender Equality program; The contract will also provide capacity building support (including on the job trainings on grant contract management/EDF procedures) to enable DRS effectively implement and manage their respective Regional Grants.
